description: Defines a Polymer web component 'paper-ripple' that provides a ripple visual effect for material design interactions, including styles, behaviors, and JavaScript logic for animation and event handling.

classes.name: ElementMetrics
classes.description: Utility class for measuring element dimensions and calculating distances.

classes.name: Ripple
classes.description: Class representing individual ripple animations, handling drawing, interaction states, and animation logic.

methods.name: Utility.distance
methods.description: Calculates Euclidean distance between two points.

methods.name: ElementMetrics.boundingRect
methods.description: Getter that returns the element's bounding rectangle.

methods.name: ElementMetrics.furthestCornerDistanceFrom
methods.description: Calculates the furthest distance from a point to the element's corners.

methods.name: Ripple.downAction
methods.description: Initiates the ripple effect at a given event position.

methods.name: Ripple.draw
methods.description: Updates the visual state of the ripple based on current interaction.
